files.title: About uploaded files
files.description: To answer, your message, conversation context and any attached file are sent to the AI provider handling the request: Gemini first, then Gemini Flash-Lite, Groq, Cloudflare Workers AI or OpenRouter if the previous provider is unavailable or rate-limited. A provider is only solicited if its API key is configured. The file contents are not saved in the app's conversation history; only its name is. Each provider processes the data under its own privacy terms (Google, Mistral AI, Groq, Cloudflare or OpenRouter).

guidance.title: Good practices on the road
guidance.subtitle: Practical guidance for everyday travel. It complements driving-school instruction and official rules.

DRIVER.title: Guidance for drivers
DRIVER.intro: Plan your trips and drive predictably, carefully, and with consideration for other road users.
tips: Check that your licence and required documents are valid and appropriate for the vehicle you use.
Before setting off, check your vehicle’s brakes, tyres, lights, and safety equipment.
Adjust your speed to road conditions, visibility, weather, and traffic.
Signal turns, leave a safe following distance, and obey right-of-way rules and signs.
Never drive under the influence of alcohol or drugs, while exhausted, or after taking medicine that affects alertness.

PASSENGER.title: Guidance for passengers
PASSENGER.intro: Your actions help keep the trip safe and allow the driver to focus.
tips: Wear a seat belt when available and follow the vehicle’s safety instructions.
On a motorcycle, wear a properly fastened, suitable helmet and keep your feet on the footrests.
Avoid distracting the driver and let them focus on traffic.
Get in and out on the safest side, away from moving traffic whenever possible.
Never encourage unsafe driving or carrying more people than the vehicle is designed for.

PEDESTRIAN.title: Guidance for pedestrians
PEDESTRIAN.intro: Stay visible, alert, and predictable, especially in busy traffic or poor visibility.
tips: Use pavements and pedestrian crossings where available.
Before crossing, look both ways and make sure approaching drivers have seen you and can stop.
Avoid crossing while looking at your phone or wearing headphones that block traffic sounds.
At night or in low visibility, wear light-coloured clothing or reflective items.
Where there is no pavement, walk carefully and position yourself so you can see approaching traffic.

CITIZEN.title: Guidance for everyone
CITIZEN.intro: Roads are shared spaces: awareness, respect, and anticipation help protect everyone.
tips: Follow signs and instructions from traffic officers, whatever your mode of travel.
Look out for pedestrians, children, older people, and other vulnerable road users.
Keep pavements, crossings, intersections, and emergency access routes clear.
Stay calm, avoid aggressive behaviour, and give way when required.
If you are unsure about a procedure or rule, check with an official source or a driving school.

faq.question: Does the assistant replace driving school?
faq.answer: No. It can support your revision, but it does not replace driving-school instruction, supervised practice, or information from the relevant authorities.

faq.question: What can I ask about?
faq.answer: Ask about road rules in Madagascar, driving licences, driving-school learning, useful procedures and documents, and good practices for drivers, passengers, and pedestrians.

faq.question: Which sources does the assistant use?
faq.answer: Reference documents approved by the administrators come first. Google Search can supplement missing information, and consulted links are shown in the answer. Confirm current rules and procedures with official sources.

faq.question: Can I tailor the guidance to my situation?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose driver, passenger, pedestrian, or citizen in your profile. You can change it at any time, and the good-practices page will adapt.

home.sourceDescription: Administrators can add official sources about driving, permits, and road use. These take priority; web search can supplement them.
home.disclaimer: This assistant is not a replacement for driving school or professional instruction. It can help anyone who needs extra support to review and better understand road rules.
